subject: P04
scope: cumulative phase review of P04 and the earlier features it affects
limitations: P04 integrated native evidence: the C13, C14 and C15 drivers ran against the single P04-prepared fixture bundle with AIRS_NATIVE_SUBJECT=P04 (native-<chunk>/, native-acceptance-<chunk>.json), merged by tools/native-acceptance/merge_phase.py into native-acceptance.json. Both registered workloads were re-measured on that bundle: the C13 Red Teaming and model-security reads and the C15 large HTTP bodies and downloads. A phase holding two workloads records each under its own name (workload-perf-C13.json, workload-perf-C15.json); xtask's workload_evidence() reads the per-chunk record in a phase and the single workload-perf.json in a chunk.

D034: every P04 chunk first completed on an 8/10 review under the owner rule and was then raised to a passing 9/10 review on the integrated tree before this phase review (raised commits: C13 bdd57c2, C14 0c6a604, C15 e9df1db). Each chunk's follow-ups file (docs/planning/reviews/<chunk>/follow-ups.md) lists the findings and their remediation.

Mutation probes: each P04 chunk's probes ran with the hardened harness on its raised tree (C13 49/49, C14 49/49, C15 51/51; 149/149 killed by their named tests). Every mutated source's SHA-256 recorded in results.json ('inputs') matches this phase tree, so no probed file changed after its run.

The Accessibility tree reader's node cap (tools/native-acceptance/ax.swift) was raised from 4,000 to 20,000 during the C13 raise, matching probe.swift's activation reader: the C13 regression's 1,000-row attack table exceeded the old cap. Drivers never save an Accessibility tree while an NSOpenPanel/NSSavePanel is shown.

No real product endpoint is called before C25. Management (Red Teaming, model security, AgentGuard), scan and the API Client's targets are synthetic local services (tools/native-acceptance/mgmt_server.py, the scan endpoint, the workbench execution fixtures). Fixture builds only; signed packages are C26.

The C07 offline storage manifest, written when the C07 driver runs as a regression under a later subject, is kept with C07's native records (native-C07/storage-manifest.json) rather than at the subject's top level.

Deferred with reasons: D039, v1's idle polling, encrypted metric history, cross-session snapshots and Home tiles for Red Teaming and model/skill security (C16-C18 own Home and observation history); D040, the Git view's hosting links and saved diff, the standalone Rusty profile migration and structured row/auth editors (edited as v1's text forms); D041, live qualification of the 193 catalogue specifications (C25).
review_instructions:
Independently review phase P04 (chunks C13, C14, C15) of Prisma AIRS Desktop
v2 as an integrated whole. Read AGENTS.md, GLOSSARY.md, decisions, ADRs, the
implementation plan, each phase chunk instruction, review-protocol.md, and the
packet's receipts and evidence. Assess how the phase's features compose with
each other and with earlier phases they affect: authority boundaries across
features, shared state, regressions, outcome truthfulness, and whether the
integrated tests and native evidence exercise the combined behavior.

Historical chunk scores are evidence to assess, not a substitute for this
review. A defect visible only across chunks is a required fix even if every
chunk passed alone. Do not edit application files, call endpoints, read
secrets, or implement fixes.

Score architecture, behavior, authority_security, validation and overall 1-10.
Return the same verdict schema as chunk reviews with the phase as subject. A
pass requires every score >=9 and empty required_fixes/blockers/evidence_gaps.
Do not inflate scores to meet the target.
